seo.title: Stay Intelligence | TripAgent
seo.description: How your advisor chooses the suite, the villa or the room itself, and how preferred-partner programmes add upgrades, breakfast and credits to a stay.

hero.headingHtml:
The right room,
not just a room.
hero.lede: A quiet library on staying well. When a suite is worth it. When a villa beats a hotel. How the room itself is chosen, and how preferred-partner programmes add upgrades, breakfast and credits. Two rooms at the same rate can be worlds apart. This is how we tell.

pullq.quoteHtml:
The room is easy to book.
The right room isn't.
pullq.lede: A guide can name a category and list what a programme may include. It can't read the floor plan, hold the upgrade in writing, or have the property expecting you by name. Read these to know the questions. Your advisor answers them.

routeGuides.heading: How a stay is really chosen.
routeGuides.lede: The suite, the villa, the room, the occasion, and how your advisor weighs each one for you.

cards.heading: When a suite is worth it
cards.body: What a suite actually buys you, and the nights it pays for itself. The honest line between the upgrade and a good room.

cards.heading: When a villa beats a hotel
cards.body: Space, privacy and a kitchen of your own against a hotel's service and address. When each one wins.

cards.heading: How the right room is chosen
cards.body: Two rooms, one rate, worlds apart. The view, the floor, the wing, and how your advisor asks for the right one.

cards.heading: Stays that work for families
cards.body: Connecting rooms, a villa with a pool, the layout that keeps everyone together, and what to confirm before you go.

cards.heading: A honeymoon, done right
cards.body: Romance without the cliché: the right suite, the quiet table, and an occasion the property already knows about.

cards.heading: How programmes add value
cards.body: Upgrades, breakfast, a property credit, a later checkout: what preferred-partner programmes include, and how they reach you.

productGuides.heading: Read a stay like an advisor.

cards.heading: Preferred-partner programmes, explained
cards.body: How recognised relationships add an upgrade, breakfast, a resort credit and a later checkout to the same room.

cards.heading: Suite vs. room: the honest line
cards.body: When the second room, the larger terrace and the lounge are worth the premium, and when a good room is the smarter call.

cta.headingHtml:
Knowing the room is one thing.
Securing it is ours.
cta.lede: These guides set the questions. Your advisor asks for the right room and the upgrade in writing, holds it while you decide, and briefs the property so you arrive expected: with the inclusions a public rate never carries.
